_comment: The externally-anchored interest floor. Per task, effect sizes from recent ACCEPTED papers; the MIE is a HIGH percentile (top-quartile) of that distribution, so the 'interesting' bar comes from the field. Values from a multi-query Semantic Scholar + Scite + arXiv pull with per-delta DOIs; unverified deltas excluded from the top-quartile. Both tasks are near-saturated, so the frontier vs raw top-quartile decision is flagged per task. Vignan verifies + signs before use.

PatchBlender (Prato et al., 2022, ViT-B)

ssv2_recognition_top1.status: CITED + leniency choice APPLIED (MIE = 0.01, the FRONTIER top-quartile, lower and more lenient than the raw 0.014). SSv2 saturates hard at the >77% frontier where accepted gains are almost all below +0.01; the raw 0.014 was inflated by two low-operating-point deltas (VideoMamba +7 pt, DEAR +0.8 pt) against weaker baselines. Vignan verifies + signs. NeurIPS/CVPR/ECCV entries venue-confirmed; PatchBlender/VideoMamba/DEAR/DejaVid acceptance unverified (arXiv-indexed).

tomato_temporal_mcq.status: STARTER (Vignan verifies + signs). TOMATO is a new (2024) hard temporal-reasoning benchmark with a wide human-model gap, so accepted method gains are larger than saturated SSv2/K400. 0.03 (+3 pt) is a defensible top-quartile placeholder; refine with a real spread of accepted TOMATO improvements before a submission-bound run.

kinetics400_recognition_top1.status: CITED + leniency choice APPLIED (MIE = 0.011, the top-quartile of the 6 confirmed frontier deltas [0.001, 0.004, 0.010, 0.010, 0.011, 0.012]). The whole K400 set is already frontier SOTA-progression, so 0.011 is both the top-quartile and the lenient value, there is no lower defensible number. Vignan verifies + signs. K400 near-saturated, SOTA moved only ~89.9 (2022) to 92.1 (2024). A CoVeR +2.4 pt claim was EXCLUDED (arXiv ID/DOI unverifiable).

intphys2_physics_binary.status: STARTER for the effect/phenomenon run (Vignan verifies + signs). IntPhys 2 (arXiv:2506.09849, Meta FAIR, Jun 2025) is synthetic Unreal renders, binary possible/impossible, judge-free. Chance 50 / Qwen2.5-VL 52.27 / best-MLLM Gemini 2.5 Flash 55.63 / best-overall V-JEPA 2 ~57.5 / human 96.44. Adjacent accepted method deltas ~+1.5-1.9 pt, best-over-baseline +5.2 pt. 0.03 (+3 pt) is a defensible top-quartile between the adjacent-method gains and the full field spread, above the 0.005 MDE. SIGNED MIE-ONLY (NO incumbent entry) so the classifier routes performance claims to EFFECT (a mechanism's trained-minus-untrained contrast), not capability, since a 7B VLM will not beat a specialized SOTA. VERIFY the exact SOTA row in arXiv:2506.09849 before signing (one automated fetch garbled a held-out sub-number, an implausible 98.3 pct; the robust facts are chance 50 / Qwen 52.27 / Gemini 55.63 / V-JEPA 2 ~57.5 / human 96.44).

videohallu_counterintuitive_qa.status: OPTIONAL secondary (Vignan verifies + signs). VideoHallu (arXiv:2505.01481) is AI-generated 2025-video-gen counterintuitive QA, 987 clips / 3,233 QA, Apache-2.0, membership-clean. Models cluster 49-54 pct (no dominant incumbent), strongest accepted delta Video-R1 RL +4.46. 0.04 (+4 pt) top-quartile driven by the Video-R1 gain. CAVEAT: scoring is LLM-as-judge (GPT-4o-mini), NOT judge-free, so it adds a judge dependency + a reproducibility knob; IntPhys 2 is the cleaner primary. Signed MIE-ONLY (effect/phenomenon). Include only if you want a second dataset this run.

generated_physics_paired._task: The engine's OWN generated paired possible/impossible physics clips over 8 violation types (solidity, permanence, immutability, continuity, gravity, momentum, collision, inertia). No external leaderboard exists for it, so per step 77 the MIE is anchored on the adjacent published genre (IntPhys 2, the same binary violation-of-expectation task) plus the human-model gap.

human_model_gap.human_accuracy: About 1.00 by construction. The per-condition human-perceptibility gate admits a violation type only if humans score about 100 percent on it, consistent with IntPhys 2 human 0.9644.
human_model_gap.model_baseline: Qwen2.5-VL-7B near chance. The on-cluster continuation-scorer smoke measured a raw paired separation of +0.073 (mean P(possible) 0.847 on possible vs 0.773 on impossible clips), so the achievable headroom is large but the MIE is the field's interesting-bar, not the whole gap.

generated_physics_paired.status: STARTER for the generated-data EFFECT run (Vignan verifies + signs). Same binary possible/impossible VoE genre as IntPhys 2, so the MIE reuses the IntPhys 2 accepted-method-delta distribution [0.015, 0.019, 0.019, 0.052], top-quartile about 0.03 (+3 pt). This is a mechanism EFFECT bar, the trained-minus-untrained contrast on the paired clips, not a capability bar. There is deliberately NO incumbent entry, so the classifier routes performance claims to EFFECT. The Garrido/LeCun result (DOI 10.48550/arXiv.2502.11831) motivates the JEPA-as-mechanism vein and the wide human-model gap, cited as motivation and not as a delta source (no fabricated number). LENIENCY KNOB for Vignan, 0.03 matches the IntPhys 2 sign. Because the generated task is cleaner (pixel-identical pairs, no render-style confound) a smaller MIE could be justified, but keep it at or above the signed mie_floor 0.01. Verify the IntPhys 2 rows in arXiv:2506.09849 before signing, they are shared with the intphys2_physics_binary entry.
